content: EDB provides primary mathematics resources and learning/teaching examples. Teachers should verify their school sequence and the applicable official curriculum. This knowledge base does not establish grade-specific official attainment requirements.

Keep the teacher’s mathematical learning objective, numbers and relationships. Reading support must not automatically reduce two-digit subtraction to single-digit subtraction. If grade and objective appear inconsistent, flag this for teacher review instead of silently changing the objective.
Align digits by place value. Use tens/ones counters or a number line appropriate to the original number range. Explain regrouping explicitly when the objective calls for it.
